notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to give Spitemare indestructible after it enters.
You have a way to deal damage to Spitemare after it enters.
description:
Cast Spitemare by paying its mana cost.
Give Spitemare indestructible.
Deal damage to Spitemare.
Spitemare triggers, dealing double that much damage to itself due to Neriv.
Repeat step 4 an arbitrarily large number of times.
Resolve the final Spitemare trigger, dealing an arbitrarily large amount of damage to any target.
